copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要接入 WhatsApp 消息的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 会新增 WhatsApp Cloud 渠道：自动复制官方适配器、注册通道、安装固定版本依赖、运行构建测试，并引导你配置 Meta 凭证。配置完成后，机器人可通过 WhatsApp 与用户一对一私聊。
howto.when: 当你说“添加 WhatsApp Cloud 渠道”“接入 WhatsApp”等，或在 /setup 流程中需要连接 WhatsApp 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp Cloud API。
say.note: 开始复制适配器并配置。

say.text: 添加 WhatsApp 渠道，用官方 Meta API。
我要连接 WhatsApp Business Cloud，开始吧。
say.note: 会提示你提供 Meta 凭证。

howto.what_en: Once installed, NanoClaw gets a new WhatsApp Cloud channel: it copies the official adapter, registers the channel, installs a pinned dependency, runs build/tests, and guides you through Meta credentials. After setup, the bot can chat 1:1 via WhatsApp.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a WhatsApp Cloud channel, connect WhatsApp, or during the /setup flow when WhatsApp integration is needed.

say_en.text: Help me connect NanoClaw to WhatsApp Cloud API.
Add a WhatsApp channel using the official Meta API.
I want to connect WhatsApp Business Cloud, let's go.
